data.camera: medium shot, standing in the Greyrat mansion rose garden
data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 格雷拉特府邸】格雷拉特家的花园里，幼年的艾莉丝提着裙摆追着蝴蝶跑过玫瑰丛，头带下的小小红发跳动着日光，贵族小姐的裙装掩不住她天生的好动——「才不是淑女该有的样子？那种规矩我才不要呢。」
data.promptProse: Young Eris runs after butterflies through the Greyrat mansion rose garden, lifting a small part of her frilled noble skirt clear of the path. Red hair, headband and ahoge move above an eager expression. The medium view includes rose borders overlapping the route and the mansion facade farther behind. Soft garden daylight illuminates ruffle edges and butterfly wings, with shifting leaf shadows across the paving around her playful childhood stride.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 格雷拉特府邸
data.identityProseOverride: Eris Greyrat from Mushoku Tensei in her childhood form, with long wavy crimson hair, red eyes, thick eyebrows, a headband and a small ahoge.
